description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called Hover, demonstrating hover event handling such as onHoverEvent, onInterceptHoverEvent, and setOnHoverListener. It includes UI components such as a message TextView, a checkbox to toggle hover interception, and a custom interceptor view within a layout. The activity updates messages based on hover events and allows toggling event interception via a checkbox.

classes.name: Hover
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates hover event handling and interception using a custom view and UI controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and assigns hover listener and checkbox change listener.
